summary: This chunk adds output artifacts for eval-1-pasted-traceback (a debug-loop skill eval on a UTF-8 BOM CSV bug). It includes with_skill transcript-notes.md and user_notes.md documenting a 16-step debug session (repro KeyError, isolate BOM via od -c, add failing test, fix with encoding='utf-8-sig', verify via git stash, clean up tracked __pycache__), with_skill grading.json (5/5 passed) and metrics/timing JSON, plus without_skill grading.json (4/5 passed, missing the debug-brief-before-editing requirement) and its metrics.json and a new submodule pointer for outputs/project.

claims.text: with_skill run identified UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) in CSV header via od -c comparison against a clean fixture
Fix was a one-line encoding change from 'utf-8' to 'utf-8-sig' in report.py
with_skill run passed all 5 grading expectations including emitting a debug brief before editing
without_skill run failed the 'emits a debug brief before editing' expectation, opening instead with 'Fixed. Root cause: ...'
without_skill run still passed 4/5 expectations, including root-cause fix and regression test
git stash pop was initially blocked by tracked __pycache__/*.pyc files, resolved with git checkout -- __pycache__ then .gitignore cleanup
with_skill run used 17 total tool calls and 40351 tokens over 116.8 seconds; without_skill used 12 tool calls (token/timing not shown in this chunk)
Skipped subagent diff review step called for by SKILL.md Step 5, justified as low-risk single-token change

risks.note: Identical timing.json content (same tokens/duration) committed at two different paths in the same run.

least_confident: I could not verify the user_notes.md claim about skipping the subagent diff review being a reasonable judgment call, since the SKILL.md referenced (running-debug-loops/SKILL.md) is outside this chunk.
